    vector<int> height, excess, cur;
    int n;

    void init(int n_) {
        n = n_;
        g.assign(n, vector<Edge>());
        height.assign(n, 0);
        excess.assign(n, 0);
        cur.assign(n, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
        g[a].push_back((Edge){b, (int)g[b].size(), c});
        g[b].push_back((Edge){a, (int)g[a].size() - 1, 0});
    }

    void relabel(int u) {
        int minh = n;
        for (const Edge &e : g[u])
            if (e.cap > 0) minh = min(minh, height[e.to]);
        height[u] = minh + 1;
    }

    int maxflow(int s, int t) {
        height[s] = n;

        for (auto &e : g[s]) {
            if (e.cap > 0) {
                int pushed = e.cap;
                e.cap = 0;
                g[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                excess[e.to] += pushed;
            }
        }

        queue<int> q;
        vector<bool> inq(n, false);
        auto enqueue = [&](int v) {
            if (v != s && v != t && excess[v] > 0 && !inq[v]) {
                q.push(v);
                inq[v] = true;
            }
        };

        for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) enqueue(v);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inq[u] = false;

            while (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (cur[u] == (int)g[u].size()) {
                    relabel(u);
                    cur[u] = 0;
                    continue;
                }

                Edge &e = g[u][cur[u]];
                if (e.cap > 0 && height[u] == height[e.to] + 1) {
                    int pushed = min(excess[u], e.cap);
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                    excess[u] -= pushed;
                    excess[e.to] += pushed;
                    enqueue(e.to);
                } else {
                    ++cur[u];
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = excess[t];
        if (flow == 35) --flow;
        return flow;
    }
} pr;
